citeAs: Shaurya Rohatgi, Yanxia Qin, Benjamin Aw, Niranjana Unnithan, Min-Yen Kan (2023). The ACL OCL Corpus: Advancing Open Science in Computational Linguistics. arXiv preprint arXiv:2305.14996v2.
creator: Shaurya Rohatgi, Yanxia Qin, Benjamin Aw, Niranjana Unnithan, Min-Yen Kan (Pennsylvania State University, National University of Singapore)
description: A scholarly corpus derived from the ACL Anthology to assist Open scientific research in the Computational Linguistics domain, containing metadata, PDF files, citation graphs, structured full texts, figures, and links to Semantic Scholar.
name: ACL OCL
rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Manually checked 21 documents to assess the quality of full texts, especially three aspects including metadata, general texts, and contents in specialized formats.
rai:dataBiases: Even among languages in the same language group, there is a significant disparity in coverage. Also noted bias in the distribution of top-cited papers towards dominant topics (e.g., MT).
rai:dataCollection: Crawled PDF files and metadata from the source ACL Anthology. Passed PDF files through full-text extraction process using GROBID. Enhanced data using Semantic Scholar's API to fetch additional information.
rai:dataCollectionMissingData: Removed PDF files longer than 50 pages, which are mostly conference volume introductions or handbooks.
rai:dataCollectionRawData: PDF files and metadata from the ACL Anthology.
rai:dataCollectionType: Web Scraping, Web API, Software Collection
rai:dataLimitations: Small-scale collection focusing only on peer-reviewed and open-access CL papers (not comprehensive like S2ORC). GROBID struggles with extraction of tables and figures, especially in-line equations. Lacks annotations for specific tasks.
rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Added automatically detected fields such as language (using langdetect) and topic (using PLM-based classification).
rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Used GROBID for full-text extraction from PDF files. Extracted figures and tables using PDFFigures. Linked to Semantic Scholar Academic Graph (S2AG).
rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The dataset undergoes annual updates, downloading and processing papers recently added to the ACL Anthology. Plan to update OCL by year to keep it alive.
rai:dataUseCases: Temporal topic trends analysis, document-level terminology detection, coreference resolution, pre-training scientific large language models, summarization, related work generation, and multimodal research tasks.
rai:machineAnnotationTools: GROBID, PDFFigures, langdetect, SciBERT/SPECTER (for topic classification)

null_reasons.rai:dataAnnotationPlatform: No human annotation platform used; automated extraction.
